run_dense_encoder_encode_queries: encode a list of query strings into dense embeddings using a query encoder and tokenizer
run_dense_encoder_encode_corpus: encode a corpus of documents into dense embeddings using a doc encoder and tokenizer
run_evaluate_model: evaluate a dense retrieval model on a BEIR dataset and return NDCG, MAP, recall metrics
run_evaluate_model_multiple: evaluate a dense retrieval model with multiple prompts and aggregate scores across all prompts
run_evaluate_model_ce: evaluate a dense retrieval model followed by cross-encoder reranking on a BEIR dataset
